purpose: Top-level design of doc-link: system boundary, overall operations and their connections, the end-to-end sequence, and common invariants that all detailed designs must keep.
summary: System boundary: doc-link handles document IDs, ToC, search, DLID resolution, reference checks, and change-impact notification
Write boundary: only DLIDs may be written to indexed documents, in frontmatter and heading line ends
Operation table: DLID assignment, ToC build, search, DLID resolution, reference check, impact notification, inconsistency check
ToC build order and handling of documents with missing or duplicate IDs
Overall sequence diagram of index-docs followed by check-impact
Unreadable reference target directories are recorded as absent and do not block confirmation
Common invariants: ID independence, real directory scans, no partial ToC publication, no stored notification state, per-key updates
Pointers to detailed designs for decisions left to them
tasks: Reviewing the write boundary for user documents
Checking consistency between requirements and design
Understanding overall doc-link operations and flow
title: DES-001 システム全体設計
